Campaign "KICK-OFF" for Phase II. All Divisions 
are planning to be in full operation by the week 
end of February 17th.

MASTER SCHEDULE PROPOSTD CHANGES 


The Downtown Division has suggested 
that we advance our report luncheons 

to help us all in maintaining a faster 
campaign operation. Upon review of 

the Master Schedule John McGiffin 
Suggests the following report luncheon 
dates: 

ist Repost Luncheon - Wednesday, Feb.21 


énd Report Luncheon - Wednesday, Feb.28 
3rd Report Luncheon - Wednesday, March 6 


Confirmation of these dates to be made 
at our opening luncheon on February 13. 


BOUQUETS 


Northwestern Division (N.D.G.) are the pace- 
setters in this year's Campaign. Their advance 
canvass returns are currently 17% of their 
Divisional Objective. 


Verdun-LaSalle Division are already talking 
about going 20% over their objective. Special 
note should be made of Alan Maislin, and his 
industrial team in LaSalle who expect to double 
their objective. 


St. Andrew area of the Downtown Divisions, led 
by Jeff Aimers and Sandy Henderson have produced 
over 1500 new prospect cards. Cam MacLeod says 
that they should be able to produce $1,000 over 
their objective of $11,000.(Don't forget the bet 
of a Steak Dinner, Cam.) 
REMINDERS 


Opening Luncheon - February 13:-12:30 NOON 
If you know of any workers who were not on 
the mailing list, be sure to bring them 
along with you. 


February 9 - 13: Mailings of all Campaign 
letters to prospects. 


February 19 - March 15: Major time for 
Canvassing. 


GOOD LUCK - If you need help, be sure to call the Campaign Office.
